method: Canny(60,160) + HoughLinesP(threshold=35,minLineLength=35,maxLineGap=8); every source is resized to width 896 using round(original_height*896/original_width), preserving aspect ratio; report segment-length-weighted means for lines within 7 degrees of each target. All edge types are included, so this is screening only, not ground-plane proof.
historical_error: The previous angle audit resized the 1774x887 v6 and v5 sources to 896x512 (1.75:1) instead of their correct aspect-preserving 896x448. The 14.3% vertical stretch falsely indicated a +30 degree family and led to an unnecessary 0.8660254 runtime Y compression. Earlier angle tables based on that resize are superseded.
runtime_decision: Remove non-uniform depth correction; use uniform backdrop scale. Keep runtime v6 because it provides the strongest continuous planted context and its aspect-preserving line-family screen is near the store axes.
